Who We Are

Welcome to Find My Career, your trusted partner in overseas graduate university placements. With over 17 years of experience, we have established ourselves as a leading provider of comprehensive services designed to help students realize their dreams of studying abroad.

Our Vision Our Values

Our Mission

To empower students by providing expert guidance and personalized support throughout their journey to higher education abroad. We strive to make the process seamless and stress-free, ensuring that each student finds the right university that aligns with their academic goals and career aspirations.

Our Vision

To be the leading global provider of educational consultancy services, fostering a future of global leaders. We envision a world where every student has the guidance, resources, and support they need to transform their academic dreams into reality.

Why Choose Us

What sets us apart in the competitive world of career guidance.

Expert Guidance

Engage with our consultants and leave confident and assured.

Multilingual Support

Services available in English, Sinhala, and Tamil.

Trust & Security

Uncompromised trustworthy service with complete confidentiality.

Transparent Process

Monitor progress every step of the way through our transparent process.

Tuition Support

Support for IELTS and other relevant academic requirements.

Empowerment

Stimulating applicant knowledge for informed decision-making.

Our Journey

Founded in 2007, Find My Career was born out of a passion for education and a commitment to guiding students through the complex process of international university applications. Over the past 17 years, we have successfully assisted thousands of students in securing placements at prestigious universities around the world.

Our Team

At the heart of Find My Career is a team of 20 dedicated, highly skilled professionals. Our team brings together a wealth of experience and expertise in international education, university admissions, and student counseling. Each member of our team is committed to providing exceptional service and personalized attention to every student we work with.
